title: Chinese Mango Coconut Pudding
summary: A silky, chilled mango pudding inspired by Chinese dim sum desserts, made vegan with coconut milk and chia seeds for a gentle set. It is creamy, fruity and refreshing after a meal.
steps: Put 400 g of the mango, the coconut milk, sugar and lime juice in a blender. Blend until completely smooth and creamy.
Pour the mango mixture into a bowl and stir in the chia seeds thoroughly, making sure there are no clumps.
Leave the mixture for 10 minutes, then stir again to evenly distribute the chia seeds as they start to thicken.
Divide between 4 small bowls or glasses. Cover and chill for at least 4 hours, until softly set and spoonable.
Top with the remaining diced mango and a sprinkle of desiccated coconut just before serving.
